The alloying components were weighed according to the designed composition and melted using vacuum arc remelting (VAR) equipment. The repetitive melting (at least 4 times) was implemented for a 250 g ingot to ensure uniform mixing of the alloying elements.
hot forging was repeated eight times at 1075 °C
followed by hot caliber rolling performed at 880 °C up to a true strain of approximately 1.3
After rolling, a final solution treatment was carried out at either 880 or 1050 °C, followed by water quenching
